title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Use enhanced chat with Copilot (Supports 20 more languages)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) enhances Copilot chat with support for 20 additional languages, improved understanding of multi-sentence prompts, and faster performance. Users can leverage AI-powered chat to find business data using natural language, get task guidance, and understand field purposes without leaving the application.
key_points: Copilot chat now supports 20 more languages than the previous release
Users can find and analyze business data by asking natural language questions about customers, vendors, sales orders, and items
Copilot provides step-by-step guidance on business tasks and explains field purposes via chat
BC27 includes improved prompt understanding for multi-sentence inputs and faster performance
Field tooltips now include an Ask Copilot option that opens chat with contextual explanations

quotes.text: Copilot in Business Central transforms how people approach business applications by empowering workers to express themselves using their own language.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core value proposition of Copilot chat, enabling conversational business interaction

quotes.text: By chatting with Copilot in Business Central, you can ask questions and find business data using natural language.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary capability of the feature, making data discovery accessible without technical knowledge
